name: Cafe Pub Black Horse
kurzbeschreibung:
**The Black Horse Café Pub in Innsbruck**

Welcome to **Café Pub Black Horse** in the heart of **Innsbruck**, where traditional Tyrolean charm meets modern pub vibes. Sip on a cold **Radler** or enjoy a hearty **Kaiserschmarrn** with a side of local **Apfelstrudel**—all while soaking in the cozy atmosphere of this beloved spot.

Whether you're craving a classic **Weißbier** or a rich **Kaffee mit Schlag**, our menu has something for every taste. Live music and a friendly crowd make this the perfect place to unwind after exploring **Tirol**’s stunning landscapes or before diving into the city’s nightlife.

Come for the drinks, stay for the stories—**Café Pub Black Horse** is more than just a stop; it’s an experience. 🍻
